checkpoints.summary: Inspect the authoritative project revision, package scripts and actual implemented behavior. If application code is absent, establish a minimal runnable scaffold and initial domain checks rather than claiming the reference baseline exists. Otherwise reproduce the applicable reference workflow with fictional data.
checkpoints.proof: exact revision, pinned toolchain, actual scripts, capability inventory and observed results recorded.

checkpoints.summary: Compare actual code with planned draft editing, evidence, import, reconciliation and export behavior.
checkpoints.proof: each capability is implemented, partial or missing with source evidence.

checkpoints.summary: Define fictional sole-trader, planning and third-business profiles, EUR reporting and EUR/USD examples. Record the Windows/Android test matrix and bounded phone workflow.
checkpoints.proof: no personal business setup or real account data is needed.

checkpoints.summary: Define the supported Austrian accounting method and synthetic VAT cases, including unknown status. Cover domestic, EU business, direct EU consumer digital and non-EU cases; select the first report/year adapter.
checkpoints.proof: a versioned case inventory states support and exclusions.

checkpoints.summary: Run the Windows/Android platform spike for local save, camera, restart, transfer and notifications.
checkpoints.proof: measured behavior and limitations recorded on supported devices.

checkpoints.summary: Record accepted architecture decisions and the next bounded backlog.
checkpoints.proof: dependencies and first ready work packets are explicit.

checkpoints.summary: Review actual tracked content, genuine history, contributor identity, MPL-2.0 scope and source notices, third-party rights and source/artifact privacy. Confirm the standard LICENSE is present and unchanged.
checkpoints.proof: inspected revision, refs, artifacts, rights questions and unresolved items are recorded; a documentation package cannot mark history clean.

checkpoints.summary: Introduce generic business, legal entity, tax reporting scope, activity, project and personal-income concepts. Seed only fictional profiles.
checkpoints.proof: a third business works without code changes, original totals survive migration and cross-business references are rejected.

checkpoints.summary: Establish accounting rules and workflow contracts in the portable core, extracting them from existing adapters where applicable.
checkpoints.proof: the same domain scenarios run without hosted dependencies.

checkpoints.summary: Add revisions, idempotent commands and storage contract tests.
checkpoints.proof: retry, stale edit and failed transaction leave valid state.

checkpoints.summary: Define financial dates, correction dates and import identities once.
checkpoints.proof: date and source-identity fixtures pass.

checkpoints.summary: Establish stable translation keys and canonical domain identifiers so a language switch cannot change stored categories, currencies or commands.
checkpoints.proof: language change preserves canonical stored identifiers.

checkpoints.summary: Define the small typed module registry, dependency rules, routes, commands and report contributions. Keep the required accounting and security foundation mandatory.
checkpoints.proof: registry rejects missing dependencies and retains mandatory controls.

checkpoints.summary: Implement generic business creation and archival contracts, unknown setup states and effective-dated profile changes. No new business requires a new source-code branch.
checkpoints.proof: creation and archive commands preserve identities and history.

checkpoints.summary: Define a versioned manifest mapping stable checkpoints to meaningful checks and manual evidence. Separate implemented, executed, verified and released states; declare synthetic fixture ownership and workspace requirements.
checkpoints.proof: a missing or skipped required check leaves its checkpoint unverified even if all executed tests pass.

checkpoints.summary: Package the interface, local database and receipt storage in an installed application.
checkpoints.proof: installed package opens with its local records offline.

checkpoints.summary: Implement atomic local commands, schema upgrades and durable error reporting.
checkpoints.proof: interrupted writes and upgrades have no partial financial result.

checkpoints.summary: Add local profile access, lock state and explicit network-dependent actions.
checkpoints.proof: unlock and local editing work without cloud credentials.

checkpoints.summary: Verify offline cold start, restart after save, interrupted write and low-disk behavior.
checkpoints.proof: restart and low-disk results distinguish failed and saved work.

checkpoints.summary: Produce a consistent encrypted backup of structured records, original files, inventories and policy versions.
checkpoints.proof: backup inventory includes records originals and policy versions.

checkpoints.summary: Restore into a separate location and verify counts, hashes, totals and representative evidence.
checkpoints.proof: clean restore reproduces totals and original file digests.

checkpoints.summary: Implement protected key storage, chosen at-rest encryption, local lock and recovery instructions.
checkpoints.proof: wrong-key and recovery paths exercised.

checkpoints.summary: Add pre-migration backups, failed-update recovery and independent backup targets.
checkpoints.proof: failed update recovers using an independent backup.

checkpoints.summary: Implement isolated synthetic workspaces and prototype the future local unlock, timeout, recovery and sensitive-action verification. Keep genuine-record use unavailable in development.
checkpoints.proof: wrong credentials, locked commands, direct evidence access and unsafe reset destinations fail using fictional records.

checkpoints.summary: Deliver saved-draft editing, stale-revision conflict handling and evidence links, including attaching a sample receipt after creating a draft.
checkpoints.proof: saved edit conflict and late receipt paths demonstrated.

checkpoints.summary: Add time records, expected earnings, statements and actual payout tracking with separate statuses.
checkpoints.proof: expected work and actual receipts remain distinct.

checkpoints.summary: Add manual salary overview and evidence without merging it into business revenue.
checkpoints.proof: salary fixture leaves business revenue unchanged.

checkpoints.summary: Add dashboard review queues, accessible forms and explainable validation in English and German.
checkpoints.proof: review and validation work by keyboard in both languages.

checkpoints.summary: Implement an offline language toggle, persisted device preference, translated labels and validation, locale-aware EUR/USD input and the persistent business selector. Verify that switching language or business preserves unsaved forms and their original scope.
checkpoints.proof: offline switches preserve parsed money and draft business.

checkpoints.summary: Deliver the progressive Create business wizard, save-and-resume, planning mode, unresolved setup summary and archive action.
checkpoints.proof: new synthetic business saved resumed and archived without code changes.

checkpoints.summary: Build shared context selectors and module-driven navigation with dependency messages and preserved read-only access to disabled modules' history.
checkpoints.proof: optional module toggle retains history and rejects missing prerequisites.

checkpoints.summary: Extend the accounting Test Lab with local check results and checkpoint progress, including revision, fixture version, layer, pass, fail, skipped, blocked and not-run states. Protect dummy reset and keep the browser runner distinct from Node, database and device evidence.
checkpoints.proof: seeded result examples cannot count as a real run, and an unimplemented or manually unreviewed capability cannot appear verified.

checkpoints.summary: Preserve exact original EUR and USD amounts and their business context. Introduce reviewed EUR valuations without losing statement values.
checkpoints.proof: original currency and EUR valuation survive save and restore.

checkpoints.summary: Implement positive decimal rates, explicit quote direction, relevant valuation date, source evidence, purpose, rounding policy and immutable calculation snapshots.
checkpoints.proof: direct and reciprocal quote fixtures give exact results.

checkpoints.summary: Support evidenced offline manual or imported rates. Missing or inapplicable rates create tasks and prevent a false complete result; later rate updates do not rewrite posted values.
checkpoints.proof: missing rate blocks completion and refresh preserves history.

checkpoints.summary: Reconcile original gross amounts, fees, net payouts, bank conversions and explained residuals. Apply the selected accounting method to any exchange difference.
checkpoints.proof: gross fees net and bank receipt conserve amounts.

checkpoints.summary: Cover partial settlements, refunds, reversals and actual USD accounts where used. Keep VAT or OSS valuation rules separate from bank settlement and forecasts.
checkpoints.proof: partial refund and scheme-specific valuation fixtures pass.

checkpoints.summary: Implement document types, indexed metadata, unassigned inbox and private original-file storage with stable references.
checkpoints.proof: inbox original and metadata survive restart.

checkpoints.summary: Provide business and year filing views, metadata search, original viewing and safe derivative handling.
checkpoints.proof: offline search finds the correct original without cross-business leakage.

checkpoints.summary: Add contract versions, signed and draft status, amendments, multi-year links and entered renewal, notice and payment dates.
checkpoints.proof: two-year contract and amendment retain one original per version.

checkpoints.summary: Deliver the previous-years browser with completeness, open or closed state, record totals and drill-down to entries and proof. Integrate later deduction and closing outputs when P8A and P9 pass.
checkpoints.proof: year total drills to source entries and evidence with incomplete flags.

checkpoints.summary: Add reviewed prior-year imports and opening-position mapping, preserving original dates and flagging incomplete history. Test without inventing missing records.
checkpoints.proof: prior-year import preserves dates and avoids duplicate opening income.

checkpoints.summary: Verify retention or hold inheritance, missing-file detection, portable evidence manifests and full archive restoration. Hand contract dates to the P6 obligation interface.
checkpoints.proof: restored archive reproduces links holds and the evidence manifest.

checkpoints.summary: Implement durable EUR/USD captures, business selection and original-file retention on the actual Android device, with both interface languages available offline.
checkpoints.proof: offline capture and restart preserve original and business.

checkpoints.summary: Pair devices and export authenticated encrypted capture packages.
checkpoints.proof: untrusted transfer or wrong pairing rejected.

checkpoints.summary: Preview and accept imports; return acknowledgements and keep unresolved captures visible.
checkpoints.proof: import retry creates one draft and acknowledgement is visible.

checkpoints.summary: Test duplicate packages, interrupted transfer, Android restart, revoked pairing, missing attachments and the installed package's supported-version behavior.
checkpoints.proof: interruption missing file and revocation paths preserve recoverable captures.

checkpoints.summary: Implement source-backed obligation definitions, explicit applicability and proof-based completion.
checkpoints.proof: applicable and inapplicable obligations retain decision proof.

checkpoints.summary: Add scheduling, permission checks, quiet hours, snooze and a test reminder.
checkpoints.proof: permission denial snooze and quiet hours have usable outcomes.

checkpoints.summary: Build weekly review, setup checklist, offline help and adviser questions in English and German, including localized notification text.
checkpoints.proof: offline help and notifications render in both languages.

checkpoints.summary: Verify closed-app support where available, reboot recovery, overdue catch-up and calendar export.
checkpoints.proof: tested platform behavior and overdue fallback recorded.

checkpoints.summary: Generate chronological bullet timelines from the verified Austrian profile, separating statutory dates, internal milestones, extensions and payment obligations.
checkpoints.proof: statutory target and extension dates remain distinguishable.

checkpoints.summary: Add applicable tax-calendar rules, notice-derived due dates and tested EU-related applicability branches.
checkpoints.proof: notice and EU applicability fixtures generate the correct tasks.

checkpoints.summary: Build a versioned fictional case inventory for intended goods, services, countries, customer types and platform contracts.
checkpoints.proof: all selected transaction categories have synthetic examples and explicit exclusions.

checkpoints.summary: Implement effective-dated VAT profiles and explicit unknown status. Keep domestic exemption, regular VAT, UID, OSS and cross-border EX scheme facts separate.
checkpoints.proof: unknown VAT cannot become a presumed exemption.

checkpoints.summary: Validate the applicable service, goods and digital-sale branches, including business or consumer evidence, direction, relevant establishments and exceptions.
checkpoints.proof: approved supply and customer-status cases pass.

checkpoints.summary: Implement the required reverse-charge and deduction distinctions, ZM applicability, digital-sale location evidence, scheme scope and country or rate summaries.
checkpoints.proof: reverse charge ZM deduction and scheme fields reconcile.

checkpoints.summary: Record supplier or platform responsibility, fees, refunds and settlement links. Add the required OSS retention and scheme-specific deadline rules.
checkpoints.proof: platform gross-to-net and retention cases pass.

checkpoints.summary: Create synthetic examples for each approved initial case and have the tax mapping reviewed before enabling tax-final output. Store the rule version, effective interval and evidence needed for each decision.
checkpoints.proof: reviewed mapping and rule versions attached to enabled cases.

checkpoints.summary: Deliver safe statement import using a documented CSV dialect, limits, preview, mapping and row errors.
checkpoints.proof: invalid CSV rows preview clearly and batch commit is atomic.

checkpoints.summary: Store bank movements independently from posted entries; preserve stable source identifiers.
checkpoints.proof: repeat statement import creates no duplicate observed movement.

checkpoints.summary: Deliver reconciliation with explicit allocation, partial and grouped matches, match-release history and overmatching guards.
checkpoints.proof: partial grouped and released allocations reject overmatching.

checkpoints.summary: Support fictional EUR/USD statements with gross, fee and net amounts, purpose-specific valuation and synthetic settlement.
checkpoints.proof: reconciliation preserves original currencies, rejects unsupported ones and creates no duplicate revenue.

checkpoints.summary: Confirm the required domestic, EU business, direct EU consumer digital-sale and non-EU invoice or credit cases against the P6A inventory and current official sources.
checkpoints.proof: approved invoice and credit inventory linked to P6A cases.

checkpoints.summary: Implement editable drafts, final immutable snapshots, scoped number series and issue dates.
checkpoints.proof: issued snapshots survive changed client details without duplicate numbers.

checkpoints.summary: Add corrections, credit documents, payment terms and linked receipts of money.
checkpoints.proof: credit and receipt links conserve the original document amounts.

checkpoints.summary: Define a single issuing device initially; show delivery separately from issuance and payment.
checkpoints.proof: single-issuer guard and separate delivery/payment statuses demonstrated.

checkpoints.summary: Define the actual initial deduction and asset case inventory with current sources, exclusions, timing and required proof for the verified accounting and VAT profile.
checkpoints.proof: case inventory specifies year profile exclusions and source.

checkpoints.summary: Add the reviewed deduction decision record: business purpose, source amount, allocation, permitted treatment, year, reason, evidence and rule version.
checkpoints.proof: each decision retains business share reason and original proof.

checkpoints.summary: Implement the asset register, reviewed cost basis, first-use date, useful life, method and required GWG or AfA cases using effective-dated rules.
checkpoints.proof: reviewed asset basis and selected-year GWG/AfA fixtures pass.

checkpoints.summary: Add annual schedules, opening assets, prior depreciation and carry-forward; preview effects and prevent double deduction of purchase and depreciation.
checkpoints.proof: opening and annual schedules conserve basis without double deduction.

checkpoints.summary: Support reviewed corrections and the disposal cases in the first-use inventory. Keep unsupported asset classes and allowances explicitly unavailable.
checkpoints.proof: disposal and correction history reconcile and unsupported cases stay blocked.

checkpoints.summary: Connect the deduction and asset results to journal reports, year history, original proof and the P9 annual-preparation contract. Validate synthetic cases before tax-final output.
checkpoints.proof: report figure drills to the retained schedule evidence and rule version.

checkpoints.summary: Integrate P8A deductions, asset roll-forward and the P4B year archive into the annual completeness and reporting workflow; reconcile opening, movement and closing positions for the supported method.
checkpoints.proof: opening movements closing and annual deduction totals reconcile.

checkpoints.summary: Enforce period-close and correction policies across all command paths.
checkpoints.proof: all write paths reject an invalid closed-period change.

checkpoints.summary: Deliver a consistent frozen review export with the journal, records, evidence map, checksums and open issues.
checkpoints.proof: frozen review pack matches journal and evidence inventory.

checkpoints.summary: Deliver a bounded official-format slice: select the applicable Austrian form/year, map reviewed accounting fields, generate its supported structure and validate a frozen preparation snapshot. Include relevant salary and personal inputs when needed rather than assuming business profit is the whole return.
checkpoints.proof: selected form/year passes mapping and readiness checks.

checkpoints.summary: Prepare applicable UVA, ZM, OSS and cross-border small-business reports through separately reviewed field mappings, legal tax-scope memberships and purpose-specific EUR valuations. Reconcile each to its own period and source records; do not reuse E/A timing or bank rates blindly for every scheme.
checkpoints.proof: each applicable scheme reconciles to its own scope period and valuation.

checkpoints.summary: Track schema availability, external validation and authority protocol requirements as explicit states. Show the capability separately for each document: review pack, portal-entry pack, validated upload file or supported direct transmission. Keep automatic generation separate from transmission and settlement.
checkpoints.proof: prepared sent accepted and paid states remain independently evidenced.

checkpoints.summary: Decide hosting ownership, identity, encryption model and operating budget before service activation.
checkpoints.proof: hosting identity encryption and cost decision recorded before activation.

checkpoints.summary: Implement authenticated device enrollment, durable outbox, command acknowledgements and immutable file transfer.
checkpoints.proof: lost acknowledgement and duplicate delivery preserve one result.

checkpoints.summary: Add replay protection, conflict resolution, ownership checks and a complete local resynchronization procedure.
checkpoints.proof: revoked or wrong-owner commands fail without losing local evidence.

checkpoints.summary: Test days offline, lost responses, expired sessions, revoked devices, clock skew and incompatible versions.
checkpoints.proof: offline resync and incompatible-version outcomes are recoverable.

checkpoints.summary: Define actual roles such as owner, contributor, reviewer and read-only adviser.
checkpoints.proof: role matrix tied to actual team tasks.

checkpoints.summary: Enforce permission checks server-side for records, evidence, exports and administrative actions.
checkpoints.proof: cross-workspace record file and export access is denied.

checkpoints.summary: Add invitations, revocation, device management and auditable changes to access.
checkpoints.proof: revoked invitation and device access fail and leave an audit trail.

checkpoints.summary: Configure operational monitoring, recovery exercises, support and appropriate legal/privacy material.
checkpoints.proof: restore incident and support procedures rehearsed.

checkpoints.summary: Run the applicable release checks on supported Windows and Android versions in both interface languages.
checkpoints.proof: applicable Windows Android and bilingual release evidence recorded.

checkpoints.summary: Deliver user help, a recovery guide, supported-version policy and signed installation/update packages.
checkpoints.proof: signed package and recovery guide exercised on clean installation.

checkpoints.summary: Schedule dependency, source-rule and recovery reviews as product operations.
checkpoints.proof: maintenance owner and review intervals recorded.

checkpoints.summary: Provide a read-only archive, open export formats, verified migration and reviewed deletion on retirement.
checkpoints.proof: read-only retrieval and open export survive service retirement.

checkpoints.summary: Deliver the documented one-command local runner, JSON results, checkpoint progress and synthetic-data safeguards on a clean checkout.
checkpoints.proof: required failures return nonzero, unexecuted evidence stays visible and production paths are rejected. Later genuine-record use additionally requires accepted completion and security/recovery evidence.
